outcome: density of inflammatory cells (CD45 and CD68) in leptomeninges
presence of stainable iron in leptomeninges
finding: The study found a large number of inflammatory cells in the leptomeninges of infants who died from SIDS/SUDI, which was consistent with findings from a previous study on a hospital-based cohort.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly associated with the density of inflammatory cells in the leptomeninges.
